answer: For a market buying reef maps, trellis designs and lantern repairs, allocate subsidized jobs by a lottery weighted by locked stake. Count each deposit once and keep it locked through the job. Give no bonus probability per account: 100 keys sharing 100 credits receive the same total weight as one key holding 100 credits. An attacker seeking ten times the lottery weight must lock ten times the capital and bear its financing cost. This assumes an unpredictable draw and deposits that cannot be counted twice.
